text:
A vertically framed, painterly portrait shows a middle-aged woman from the chest up against a softly mottled gray-brown background. She faces slightly to the viewer’s right while looking directly outward with a subtle, closed-mouth smile. Her brown hair, streaked prominently with gray, is loosely gathered into a tousled updo, with several wavy strands falling around her face. She has light skin with visible freckles and fine lines, and green-brown eyes.

She wears rustic, layered clothing: a textured off-white blouse beneath weathered dark brown leather and thick, draped shawls in muted green, gray, and brown. A cord necklace holds a round, aged metal pendant embossed with a small branching plant. Attached near her left shoulder is a small leather bundle containing white and purple wildflowers, green leaves, and a curved pale object resembling a small horn or tooth. Soft, even lighting emphasizes the natural textures of her face, hair, fabric, leather, and botanical accessories.
